plugins.name: zcode-wallpaper
plugins.description: Live Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers inside ZCode: real-time WebWallGL rendering (particles / SceneScript / mouse parallax, no recording), a native settings section, cross-machine .zw.zip packages, and Monet dynamic theming.

description_i18n.en: Live Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers inside ZCode: real-time WebWallGL rendering (particles / SceneScript / mouse parallax, no recording), a native settings section, cross-machine .zw.zip packages, and Monet dynamic theming.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在 ZCode 桌面客户端内实时渲染 Wallpaper Engine 场景壁纸：WebWallGL 实时渲染（粒子 / SceneScript / 鼠标视差，不录屏），原生设置区块、跨机 .zw.zip 资源包与 Monet 动态取色。
